form.title: Title
form.rubricHint: A JSON list of criteria: criterion, description, competency code and keywords. Example:

assessmentsPage.title: Assessments
assessmentsPage.subtitle: Assessment versions and the question bank. Editing an answered question saves a new version, so completed results never change.

competenciesPage.title: Competencies
competenciesPage.subtitle: EntreComp competencies, their descriptions, priorities, default targets and translations. Only published competencies are offered to learners.

learningPage.title: Learning content
learningPage.subtitle: Learning resources and practical tasks. Drafts and archived items are hidden from learners; their history is kept.

aiPage.title: AI governance
aiPage.subtitle: Every AI evaluation is logged with its provider, prompt version, latency and fallback status.

content.noMatchesText: No records match the selected filters.

errors.duration: Duration must be a whole number of minutes above zero
errors.slug: Slug: at least 2 characters, lowercase Latin letters, digits and “-” only
errors.title: Title: at least 3 characters
errors.minLength: Minimum answer length must be a whole number from 0

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.subtitle: All subscriptions, current and past. Open a user to grant, extend or cancel.
subscriptions.emptyText: Everyone matching these filters is on the free plan.

plans.title: Plans
plans.subtitle: Prices and limits are enforced by the server for every request. Changing a plan affects all its subscribers immediately.

form.keyHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, - and _. Can't be changed later.
form.name: Name
form.availableDefaultHint: The default plan can't be deactivated.
form.sortOrderHint: Plans with a lower number are shown first.

auditLogs.title: Audit log
auditLogs.subtitle: Append-only record of security-relevant and administrative actions. Passwords, tokens and secrets are never logged.
auditLogs.caption: Audit log entries, newest first
auditLogs.emptyText: Try a wider date range or remove a filter.

settings.title: Platform settings
settings.subtitle: Read-only status. Settings are changed through environment variables and a restart; secrets are never shown.
settings.notProduction: This instance is not running in production mode.

email.title: Email
email.notDelivered: Password reset and confirmation emails are not delivered. Configure SMTP_* variables and EMAIL_BACKEND=smtp.

payments.title: Payments
payments.noteNotConfigured: No payment provider is connected: online payment is unavailable and paid plans are granted by administrators.
payments.noteConfigured: Payment-provider webhooks are configured, but checkout on the site is not available yet. Paid plans can be granted manually.
payments.noteCheckout: Online payment is connected: learners can buy a paid plan themselves.

assessments.deactivateText: New attempts can't start with it. Completed attempts and scores are kept.
assessments.hint: Learners take the first active assessment. Manage its questions in the Question bank tab.

errors.code: Code: 2–48 characters, lowercase Latin letters, digits, “-” and “_” only
errors.title: Title: 3 to 160 characters
errors.minutes: A whole number of minutes from 1 to 240

assessments.emptyText: Create an assessment, then add questions to it.

questions.deactivateText: It disappears from new attempts. Existing answers and scores are kept.

errors.weight: Line {{line}}: the weight must be a number above 0 and at most 1
errors.noCompetency: Link the question to at least one competency
errors.minLength: Minimum answer length must be a whole number from 0 to 2,000
errors.textShort: The question text must be at least 10 characters

questions.noAssessmentsText: Every question belongs to an assessment. Create one on the Assessments tab, then add questions.
questions.emptyTitle: This assessment has no questions yet
questions.emptyText: Add the first question with “New question”.

resources.unpublishText: Learners won't see it in the catalogue any more. Their progress is kept and you can publish it again.

tasks.unpublishText: Learners won't be offered this task any more. Their submissions are kept.

form.name: Name
form.codeHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, dashes and underscores; can't be changed later

errors.code: Code: at least 2 characters, lowercase Latin letters, digits, “-” and “_” only
errors.numbers: Importance and learning priority must be between 0 and 1, the default target between 40 and 100

competencies.emptyText: Create the first competency in one of the areas.
competencies.noAreas: The server didn't provide competency area ids, so a new competency can't be created yet. Update the server or contact the developers.

ai.emptyEvaluationsText: They appear when learners answer open questions or submit practical tasks.
ai.readOnly: You have view-only access. Creating and activating prompt versions requires the “Manage AI” permission.
ai.emptyPromptsText: The built-in prompt is used for now.
ai.activateText: All new AI evaluations will use this version. The currently active version is switched off; past results are unchanged.

analyses.intro: One AI development analysis per completed assessment. Only processing information is shown here, not the learner's answers or the analysis text.

retried.failed: The analysis failed again. See the problem column.

analyses.emptyText: Analyses appear here after learners complete a full assessment.

usage.intro: AI configuration (the key itself is never shown), request limits and how AI calls went in the chosen period. No learner content.

confirm.publishText: Learners will see it on the platform right away.
confirm.unpublishText: Learners stop seeing it. Their history is kept and you can publish it again later.
confirm.archiveText: It is no longer offered in new assessments, catalogues or plans. Learners' history and past results are kept.

conflict.title: Someone else changed this record
conflict.text: Your changes were not saved, so nothing was overwritten. Load the latest version and apply your changes again.

sync.draftHint: New content is saved as a draft. Publish it when it is ready for learners.
sync.newVersion: Saved as version {{n}}. Completed attempts keep the previous version.
sync.versionHint_one: This question already has {{count}} answer. Changing its wording or scoring saves a new version for new attempts; past results stay unchanged.
sync.versionHint_few: This question already has {{count}} answers. Changing its wording or scoring saves a new version for new attempts; past results stay unchanged.
sync.versionHint_many: This question already has {{count}} answers. Changing its wording or scoring saves a new version for new attempts; past results stay unchanged.
sync.versionHint_other: This question already has {{count}} answers. Changing its wording or scoring saves a new version for new attempts; past results stay unchanged.
